LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.0.label: fitting giant apparel
LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.0.description: Apparel sewn and forged for giants; finally no more squeezing into scraps of mortal cloth.
LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.1.label: fitting giant apparel (two pieces)
LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.1.description: Apparel sewn and forged for giants; finally no more squeezing into scraps of mortal cloth.
LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.2.label: fitting giant apparel (three pieces)
LanguageData.LP_GiantAttire.stages.2.description: Giant apparel from head to toe; walking like a true giant.
LanguageData.LP_OrdningAbove.stages.0.label: ordered ordning
LanguageData.LP_OrdningAbove.stages.0.description: There are giants of higher rank than me here. Every giant knows their place in the ordning, and that's reassuring.
LanguageData.LP_OrdningBelow.stages.0.label: commanding the giants
LanguageData.LP_OrdningBelow.stages.0.description: There are giants of lower rank than me here; they ought to listen to me.
LanguageData.LP_ClanHead.stages.0.label: clan chief
LanguageData.LP_ClanHead.stages.0.description: With axe or with craft, no one in the clan can match me. I am the chief of this clan.
LanguageData.LP_GiantTongue.stages.0.label: tongue of kin
LanguageData.LP_GiantTongue.stages.0.description: There are other giants here; I can finally talk freely in the giant tongue.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_FireFrost.stages.0.des: Frost giants from the ice fields; our two races have fought for thousands of years. Living with these types makes even the hearth fire go cold.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_FireFrost.stages.1.des: We've been through so many days together; that frost giant isn't so bad after all.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_FrostFire.stages.0.des: Ash-covered fire giants who think they rank above us in the ordning. Living with these types turns even the snow to mud.
LanguageData.LP_RacialRelation_FrostFire.stages.1.des: We've been through so many days together; that fire giant isn't so bad after all.
